name: thirtysixbeech-blocks
description: Example block scaffolded with Create Block tool.
author: The WordPress Contributors

scripts.build: wp-scripts build --blocks-manifest; postcss src/style.css -o build/assets/css/main.css && postcss src/editor.css -o build/assets/css/editor.css
scripts.start: wp-scripts start --blocks-manifest && postcss src/style.css -o build/assets/css/main.css --watch && postcss src/editor.css -o build/assets/css/editor.css --watch
scripts.build:css: postcss src/style.css -o build/assets/css/main.css && postcss src/editor.css -o build/assets/css/editor.css
scripts.watch:css: postcss src/style.css -o build/assets/css/main.css --watch & postcss src/editor.css -o build/assets/css/editor.css --watch
